findings.body: A later round accepts any numbered reply unchanged. If round 1 has findings 1 and 2 and the reader replies to round 2 with `1. New gap`, the notes contain two finding 1s instead of numbering the new finding after 2. `_findings` then uses the number as a dictionary key, so the new finding replaces the older one when Forge builds the next prompt. Validate or renumber later-round replies before recording them.

findings.body: Every nonzero result from `claude --resume` is treated as a lost session and immediately retried with a new session. A resumed round that fails for another reason can therefore produce a successful fresh read and be recorded, although the requirement says a failed round records nothing and its retry starts fresh. The existing Claude worker distinguishes a missing-session response from other failures; this path needs the same distinction.
